title: TikTok Shop Affiliate(Creator Collaboration)Developer onboarding & termination Rules
content:
# Overview This page explains how developers apply for the TikTok Shop Affiliate Creator Collaboration category and which violations can lead to termination. Creator Collaboration is an approval-gated affiliate integration category. Do not describe this category as beta-only unless the Partner Center category page or the product operations owner explicitly confirms that status. As of July 7, 2026, affiliate API groups are available in the OpenAPI reference, but access still requires category review and API scope approval. The onboarding and termination rules can change as the business develops. Partner Center, the latest API reference, and written guidance from the TikTok Shop Open Platform team take precedence over this page. Public app publishing is a separate process. After category and API access are approved, public apps must still complete app testing, app review, listing, and compliance review before they can go online. See [Publish and list a public App](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/publish-and-list-public-app). # Scope and Category This rule applies to developers who want to provide Creator Collaboration or Affiliate software to TikTok Shop merchants, creators, or partners. The original draft limited the scope to developers registered in the United States. The market table below shows that the category is not US-only. Eligibility depends on seller market, seller type, and Partner Center approval. If your market or seller type is not listed as open, contact your partner manager or submit a Partner Center ticket before building against the APIs. Use the current Partner Center category path: ```Plain Text TikTok Shop Partner Center > App Developer > Customer Engagement > Creator collaborations ``` This is the same affiliate business area referenced by the [Affiliate integration](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/affiliate-integration) guide. Keep the naming aligned as `Customer Engagement > Creator collaborations` or `Customer Engagement > Affiliate`, depending on the latest UI label. [Original screenshot: Partner Center category path](https://sf16-sg.tiktokcdn.com/obj/eden-sg/jvK_ylwvslclK_JWZ[[/ljhwZthlaukjlkulzlp/Developer_Guide/affiliate_integretion/2.PNG)
# Available Markets and Sellers The current market availability table from the source material is transcribed below. `L2L` means local-to-local sellers, and `CB` means cross-border sellers. `ACCU` is retained as shown in the source table. | Seller market | Seller type | Open status | | --- | --- | --- | | US | L2L and ACCU | Open | | US | CB | Not open | | UK | L2L | Open, but remains gated | | UK | CB | Not open | | MX / BR | L2L | Not open | | MX / BR | CB | Not open | | EU5 | L2L | Not open | | ID | L2L | Open | | MY / TH / VN / PH / SG | L2L | Open | | MY / TH / VN / PH / SG | CB | Open | For markets or seller types not shown in the table, do not assume availability. Confirm through Partner Center or the TikTok Shop Open Platform team. [Original screenshot: Available market and seller table](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5f27940d3ee64248ae9e912a18cc80e8~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Onboarding Process The onboarding process has four stages: | Step | Owner | Action | Expected result | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | Developer | Submit the Creator Collaboration category application in Partner Center. Include all required company and service capability materials. | The application enters platform review. | | 2 | Platform | Review the category application. | The platform announces the review result, normally within 7 working days after submission. | | 3 | Partner or developer | After category approval, apply for the required affiliate APIs and scopes in TikTok Shop Partner Center. | API access is granted if the scope application is approved. | | 4 | Partner or developer | Start integration development. | The app can develop against the approved APIs and continue through app testing and review if it will be published. | The Affiliate API application is jointly reviewed by product operations, product management, and technical teams related to the TikTok Shop Affiliate API project. Review is based on developer strength, product function design, and technical feasibility. [Original screenshot: Onboarding process](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ca3abb3447514e92982d8fbee2461fa3~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Onboarding Requirements ## Company Certification Applicants must meet both company certification requirements: | Requirement | Detail | | --- | --- | | Company age and qualification | The company must have been registered for at least one year and must hold local business qualifications in the target market. | | Partner Center history | The partner must not have been previously terminated by TikTok Shop Partner Center. | ## Service Capability Proof Applicants must provide company and product capability evidence. | Evidence type | Required content | | --- | --- | | Company introduction | Official website, main business scope, employee size, organizational structure, and other relevant company information. | | Existing product proof | If the applicant has built SaaS or customized software tools before, provide the online address, a test account, or screenshots of the software interface and functions. | ## Merchant or Creator Collaboration Proof Applicants must also meet at least one applicable collaboration proof path: | Applicant type | Requirement | | --- | --- | | Seller | Monthly GMV above USD 12,500 and existing collaborations with good creator response rates. | | TSP / ISV partner | At least one valid TSP / ISV developer category certification. The partner must represent at least 5 sellers with sales above USD 12,500 per month, or the collaborated sellers must have total GMV above USD 600,000 per month. These sellers must be valid app or service authorization sellers. Existing collaborations must have good creator response rates. | | TAP or other partner, cross-channel business | At least one valid ISV / TAP category certification. If the business operates across social media channels with non-TikTok Shop creators or publishers, provide an app demo. | | TAP or CAP partner, TikTok-only business | TAP / CAP GMV above USD 12,500 per month, or collaboration with more than 100 creators. Existing collaborations must have good creator response rates. | [Original screenshot: Onboarding requirements](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bdefa30b751849ec83507b860e59a001~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
# Termination Rules The platform may terminate developers who violate any bottom-line rule. The source image lists every code below with the same enforcement action: termination. For the full policy page, see [Developer termination rules](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6506bc5ede672602b7bc0efb). | Code | Bottom-line violation | Enforcement | | --- | --- | --- | | P0-1 | Acts that threaten platform security or place TikTok e-commerce business in risk scenarios, including political risk, ethnicity, military affairs, diplomacy, historical figures, discriminatory speech, pornography or soft porn, violence, gambling, and other topics that violate platform rules. | Termination | | P0-2 | Commercial bribery, including a partner or its employees offering or promising benefits to platform employees to gain trading opportunities, obtain competitive advantages, or influence decisions. | Termination | | P0-3 | Information disclosure, including unauthorized disclosure of platform business data, merchant data, user personal information, or core business information, as well as leaving such data in an unsafe place or sharing it publicly without authorization. | Termination | | P0-4 | Forgery of qualifications, including falsifying company licenses, business qualifications, historical performance, documents, or files; concealing facts; providing false materials; or causing severe financial or reputational damage to the platform. | Termination | | P0-5 | Severe violations of platform rules, including underground industry participation, exploiting loopholes or moderation mechanisms, developing secondary agents that damage the platform, failing to prevent employee violations, failing to implement required risk management, or introducing unauthorized partners that commit serious violations. | Termination | | P0-6 | Charging fees or obtaining benefits without authorization, including undisclosed non-free items, direct fee charging, requiring merchants to pay third parties, deposits under other names, selling platform resources without permission, disrupting the platform, malicious collusion, order brushing, fraud, gambling, pornography, fraudulent identity use, profiteering, or malicious fraud. | Termination | | P0-7 | Publishing negative or inaccurate information in the platform's name, or defaming or damaging the platform's reputation. | Termination | | P0-9 | Illegal issues and other serious violations. | Termination | Note: The source image does not list a `P0-8` row. Do not infer or add a `P0-8` rule unless the latest termination policy explicitly includes it. [Original screenshot: Termination bottom-line rules](https://sf16-sg.tiktokcdn.com/obj/eden-sg/jvK_ylwvslclK_JWZ[[/ljhwZthlaukjlkulzlp/Developer_Guide/affiliate_integretion/whiteboard_exported_image_14.png)
